targetFields.text: Delo, študij ali družina: s katerim statusom na Tajvan?
Prebivanje na Tajvanu zaradi dela, študija in družine
Brezvizumski prihod omogoča nekatere prijave strokovnjakov, pri študiju pa lahko zapre običajno pot do prebivanja. Pogoji so odvisni tudi od družinskega člana in namena vizuma.
Zaprt prenosnik, knjige in dve skodelici ob nevtralni potni knjižici.
Izmišljen prizor
Ali lahko po brezvizumskem prihodu zaprosim za prebivanje?

Za upravičene tuje strokovnjake z delovnim dovoljenjem ali ustrezno izjemo 16. člen posebnega zakona omogoča neposredno prijavo pri NIA. Posebej določa pot za nekatere družinske člane. Preveriti je treba tudi uporabljeno ureditev vstopa. Običajni poti za študij in učenje kitajščine imata drugačne vstopne pogoje.
Koliko časa moram obiskovati tečaj kitajščine pred prijavo za prebivanje?

Pot zahteva ustrezen vizum za obisk zaradi učenja jezika, štiri zaključene mesece pri upravičenem univerzitetnem jezikovnem centru in vpis še za najmanj tri mesece. Izpolniti je treba tudi pogoje glede ur, navzočnosti in dokazil. Samo plačilo tečaja ne zadostuje.
Ali vsak imetnik ARC lahko omogoči prebivanje zakoncu?

Ne. Odločilni so državljanstvo in status družinskega člana na Tajvanu, sorodstveno razmerje ter način vstopa prosilca. Pravila za družino tujega strokovnjaka in za zakonca tajvanskega državljana so različna; zakon nekatere kategorije izključuje.

sourcePassages.text: Visa-exempt entry may suit a qualifying professional who intends to apply for residence in Taiwan, but it can rule out the ordinary in-country application for a degree or Mandarin student. Foreign Professionals Act Article 16 permits the professional route; BOCA's degree-study and Mandarin-study guidance set different entry conditions for students.
Nationality and the passport used determine visa eligibility. The Taiwan overseas mission handling your application provides the nationality-specific requirements and document procedures.

A temporary visitor's permitted activities and length of stay depend on the entry arrangement granted. A longer move requires a residence basis, such as employment, study or joining family. BOCA's resident-visa guidance covers those purposes, while the National Immigration Agency (NIA) decides residence applications and issues the Alien Resident Certificate (ARC).
Some eligible visitors can apply directly to NIA. Other applicants need the appropriate visa before entry, so arriving as a visitor leaves no general right to convert a short stay into residence.

For most foreign professional hires, the employer applies for a work permit, subject to statutory exceptions and the authority responsible for the job. Articles 4 and 5 of the Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals define professional work and the permit framework. A signed offer is not work authorization.

Once a qualifying foreign professional or foreign specialist professional has the permit or an applicable exemption, Article 16 allows a direct residence application following visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. NIA must still approve the residence application before issuing an ARC. The current Article 16 took effect on January 1, 2026, as recorded in the Act's legislative history.

NIA's guide excludes trial visa exemptions, the Southeast Asian online travel-authorization scheme and other listed entry arrangements from this direct-application route unless another rule applies, even where the applicant holds work approval.

Care work, fishing and other migrant-worker categories under Employment Service Act Article 46 have their own rules. NIA's migrant-worker residence procedure applies to those categories; employment in Taiwan does not by itself place a worker within the foreign-professional scheme. The category on the work approval identifies which procedure to use.

Full-time foreign students applying from abroad can seek a resident visa at a Taiwan overseas mission. Those who enter on a visitor visa specifically for foreign-student study may apply directly to NIA for residence. The ordinary in-country study route in BOCA's student guidance excludes visa-exempt entry, landing visas and visitor visas issued for other purposes.

Depending on the application, BOCA also requires educational records, financial evidence and a health certificate alongside the admission letter; the program's checklist determines which overseas records need authentication.

For Mandarin learners, the language-study visitor visa ordinarily comes before arrival. Eligibility for residence follows four completed months at a qualifying university-affiliated center, with registration for at least three more months. BOCA's Mandarin residence guidance requires at least 15 classroom hours a week, Monday through Friday. Absences, including leave, may not exceed one quarter of class hours. Tuition payment alone does not establish eligibility.

Can a student take a part-time job? Employment Service Act Articles 43 and 50 govern work permits and specified student employment. The admission letter and student ARC do not replace the work authorization needed for the job.

Family residence depends on the sponsor's status and the relationship. For a spouse of a Taiwan national residing in Taiwan with household registration, one in-country route under Immigration Act Article 23 requires a valid visa allowing a stay of at least 60 days and without the specified restrictions. Marriage therefore does not establish a general right to convert visa-exempt entry to residence. The required relationship documents and related status issues appear in residence through a Taiwan spouse.

When a foreign professional engaged in professional work in Taiwan or a foreign specialist professional already has approved residence or permanent residence, Article 16 allows certain family members to apply directly after visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. It covers a spouse, minor children, and adult children unable to care for themselves because of physical or mental disability. Parents and other adult children are excluded.

Work rights vary by family category. Employment Service Act Article 48 provides a work-permit exemption for an approved resident married to a Taiwan national with household registration. Dependent spouses of foreign professionals cannot assume that exemption applies to them. For qualifying spouses of specialist or senior professionals, Foreign Professionals Act Article 15 provides a direct application for a work permit.

Specialist professionals who meet the program's criteria may qualify for an Employment Gold Card, which combines work, residence, visa and re-entry functions in one document. The Gold Card article covers that application separately.
BOCA publishes the entrepreneur route requirements for applicants planning to establish a business in Taiwan.

Working-holiday access depends on the nationality-specific program. The digital-nomad visitor visa has separate nationality and qualification requirements and does not automatically lead to an ARC. Foreign Professionals Act Article 14 limits that remote-work route to qualifying work without providing services to Taiwan businesses or employers.

Once the residence category and entry requirements are established, the first ARC application guide covers filing and collection. An existing resident moving to a new job, course or family basis also needs the rules on renewal and changes: the current card does not settle whether that new purpose qualifies.

Sources checked October 24, 2026. Eligibility still depends on the individual application. These routes concern foreign nationals; Mainland China residents, Hong Kong and Macau residents, and ROC nationals without household registration follow separate frameworks.

The residence route requires the appropriate study visitor visa, four completed months at a qualifying university-affiliated language center, and registration for at least three further months. targetPassages.text: Sprejem na univerzo še ne pove, s katerim vizumom naj študent pride na Tajvan. Pri običajni študijski poti lahko brezvizumski prihod onemogoči prijavo za prebivanje v državi, medtem ko 16. člen zakona o tujih strokovnjakih nekaterim strokovnjakom takšno neposredno prijavo omogoča. Zato je treba namen selitve povezati z vstopnim statusom pred potovanjem.

BOCA za redni študij in učenje kitajščine objavlja ločene pogoje. Državljanstvo in uporabljeni potni list vplivata na vizumsko upravičenost. Podrobnosti za konkretno prijavo poda pristojno tajvansko predstavništvo.

Kratkotrajno bivanje ima dovoljen namen in končni datum, ki izhajata iz odobrenega načina vstopa. Za daljšo selitev je potrebna podlaga za prebivanje, denimo delo, študij ali družinska vez. Navodila BOCA za vizume za prebivanje obravnavajo te namene, o prebivanju in izkaznici ARC pa odloča Nacionalna agencija za priseljevanje, NIA.

Nekateri obiskovalci lahko zaprosijo neposredno pri NIA. Drugi potrebujejo ustrezen vizum že pred prihodom. Zgolj dejstvo, da ste zakonito vstopili in našli stanovanje, zato ne potrdi možnosti spremembe statusa.

Delodajalec pri večini zaposlitev tujih strokovnjakov zaprosi za delovno dovoljenje. 4. in 5. člen zakona o pridobivanju in zaposlovanju tujih strokovnjakov določata strokovno delo, sistem dovoljenj in izjeme; pristojni organ je odvisen tudi od vrste dela. Podpisana ponudba sama ne dovoljuje začetka dela.

Ko ima tuji strokovnjak ali strokovnjak s posebnimi znanji dovoljenje za strokovno delo oziroma ustrezno zakonsko izjemo, mu 16. člen po brezvizumskem vstopu ali vstopu z vizumom za obisk omogoča neposredno prošnjo za prebivanje. NIA mora prošnjo odobriti, preden izda ARC. Sedanja ureditev tega člena velja od 1. januarja 2026, kot izhaja iz uradne zgodovine zakona.

Preveriti je treba natančno ureditev vstopa. Navodila NIA iz te neposredne poti izključujejo poskusne brezvizumske ureditve, spletno potovalno dovoljenje za določene države jugovzhodne Azije in druge navedene možnosti, razen kadar se uporablja druga določba. Delovno dovoljenje samo ne odpravi teh omejitev.

Negovalno delo, ribištvo in druge kategorije delavcev po 46. členu zakona o zaposlitvenih storitvah imajo svoja pravila. Zanje NIA objavlja poseben postopek za prebivanje delavcev. Kategorijo poiščite na odobritvi dela; vsaka zaposlitev na Tajvanu ne spada v sistem tujih strokovnjakov.

Tuji študenti rednega študija lahko iz tujine zaprosijo za vizum za prebivanje pri tajvanskem predstavništvu. Kdor vstopi z vizumom za obisk, izdanim prav zaradi študija tujega študenta, lahko po ustrezni poti zaprosi neposredno pri NIA. Običajna prijava za študijsko prebivanje na Tajvanu po navodilih BOCA ni na voljo po brezvizumskem vstopu, vizumu ob prihodu ali vizumu za obisk z drugim namenom.

Poleg sprejemnega pisma lahko konkretna prijava zahteva dokazila o izobrazbi, finančnih sredstvih in zdravstvenem pregledu. Seznam izbrane poti določa tudi overitve tujih listin. Shranite potrdilo, za kateri program in način študija ste bili sprejeti.

Pri učenju kitajščine se vizum za obisk zaradi jezikovnega študija praviloma pridobi pred prihodom. Za prebivanje je treba pri upravičenem jezikovnem centru, povezanem z univerzo, zaključiti štiri mesece učenja in se vpisati še za najmanj tri mesece. Po navodilih BOCA za jezikovno prebivanje mora pouk od ponedeljka do petka obsegati vsaj 15 ur na teden, odsotnosti skupaj z dovoljenimi izostanki pa ne smejo preseči četrtine učnih ur. Plačana šolnina teh pogojev ne nadomesti.

Ali študentski ARC omogoča popoldansko delo? 43. in 50. člen zakona o zaposlitvenih storitvah urejata potrebno dovoljenje in študentsko zaposlitev. Za študente, ki sodijo v to ureditev, je delo omejeno na 20 ur na teden, razen med poletnimi in zimskimi počitnicami. Izkaznica o prebivanju in sprejemno pismo sama ne nadomestita dovoljenja.

Pri zakoncu tajvanskega državljana sta pomembni njegovo prebivanje na Tajvanu in gospodinjska registracija. Ena od poti znotraj države po 23. členu zakona o priseljevanju zahteva veljaven vizum, ki dovoljuje vsaj 60 dni bivanja, brez prepovedi podaljšanja in drugih navedenih omejitev. Poroka torej ne daje splošne pravice do spremembe brezvizumskega obiska v prebivanje. Dokumentacija za zakonca tajvanskega državljana je podrobneje opisana v angleščini.

Za družino tujega strokovnjaka 16. člen posebnega zakona loči dve možnosti. Družinski član na Tajvanu je lahko običajni tuji strokovnjak, ki tam opravlja strokovno delo, ali tuji strokovnjak s posebnimi znanji. V obeh primerih mora imeti pri NIA odobreno prebivanje ali stalno prebivanje.

Neposredno lahko po brezvizumskem vstopu ali vizumu za obisk zaprosijo njegov zakonec, mladoletni otroci in odrasli otroci, ki zaradi telesne ali duševne oviranosti ne morejo skrbeti zase. ARC dobijo po odobritvi. Staršev in drugih odraslih otrok ta določba ne vključuje. Pri drugih družinskih poteh je treba preveriti še zakonske izključitve glede statusa osebe, na katero se prijava opira.

Pravica do dela sledi lastnim pravilom. 48. člen zakona o zaposlitvenih storitvah dovoljuje izjemo od delovnega dovoljenja tujcu z odobrenim prebivanjem, ki je poročen s tajvanskim državljanom z gospodinjsko registracijo. Zakonec tujega strokovnjaka te izjeme ne pridobi samodejno. Upravičenemu zakoncu strokovnjaka s posebnimi znanji ali strokovnjaka na najvišji ravni 15. člen posebnega zakona omogoča lastno prošnjo za delovno dovoljenje. Njegova veljavnost ne sme preseči dovoljenega družinskega prebivanja.

Employment Gold Card združuje delovno dovoljenje, vizum za prebivanje, ARC in dovoljenje za ponovni vstop. Namenjena je strokovnjakom s posebnimi znanji, ki izpolnijo merila programa, in velja od enega do treh let. O prošnji ni odločeno že s tem, da ima kandidat dobro ponudbo za delo. Ločena razlaga prijave za Gold Card je v angleščini.

Za ustanavljanje podjetja BOCA objavlja pogoje podjetniške poti. Poslovni načrt je zato treba povezati s kategorijo prebivanja in njenimi dokazili, preden se zanesete na predvideni datum začetka poslovanja.

Delovne počitnice so vezane na program za konkretno državljanstvo. Vizum za obisk digitalnih nomadov ima druge pogoje glede državljanstva in upravičenosti ter ne vodi samodejno do ARC. 14. člen zakona o tujih strokovnjakih to pot dela na daljavo omejuje na upravičeno delo brez opravljanja storitev za tajvanska podjetja ali delodajalce.

Ko je podlaga izbrana, vodnik za prvi ARC poveže rok, listine in prevzem. Če ARC že imate in menjate službo, študij ali družinsko podlago, preverite pravila o spremembi razloga in podaljšanju. V spisu naj bosta razvidna odobreni sedanji namen in dejanski namen po spremembi.

Besedilo uporablja uradne vire, preverjene 24. in 25. oktobra 2026. Obravnava tuje državljane; prebivalci celinske Kitajske, Hongkonga in Macaa ter tajvanski državljani brez gospodinjske registracije imajo ločene pravne okvire. Upravičenost je treba ugotoviti za konkretnega prosilca.
Zakon o pridobivanju in zaposlovanju tujih strokovnjakov, 4., 5., 9., 14., 15. in 16. člen; uradna zgodovina.

Ali lahko po brezvizumskem prihodu zaprosim za prebivanje?

Za upravičene tuje strokovnjake z delovnim dovoljenjem ali ustrezno izjemo 16. člen posebnega zakona omogoča neposredno prijavo pri NIA. Posebej določa pot za nekatere družinske člane. Pot zahteva ustrezen vizum za obisk zaradi učenja jezika, štiri zaključene mesece pri upravičenem univerzitetnem jezikovnem centru in vpis še za najmanj tri mesece. Izpolniti je treba tudi pogoje glede ur, navzočnosti in dokazil. Samo plačilo tečaja ne zadostuje.
Ali vsak imetnik ARC lahko omogoči prebivanje zakoncu?

Ne. Odločilni so državljanstvo in status družinskega člana na Tajvanu, sorodstveno razmerje ter način vstopa prosilca. Pravila za družino tujega strokovnjaka in za zakonca tajvanskega državljana so različna; zakon nekatere kategorije izključuje.

Visa-exempt entry may suit a qualifying professional who intends to apply for residence in Taiwan, but it can rule out the ordinary in-country application for a degree or Mandarin student. [Foreign Professionals Act Article 16](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) permits the professional route; BOCA's [degree-study](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-283-c4da3-2.html) and [Mandarin-study guidance](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-158-260-9690c-2.html) set different entry conditions for students.

Nationality and the passport used determine visa eligibility. The [Taiwan overseas mission handling your application](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html) provides the nationality-specific requirements and document procedures.

## Permission for a visit and permission to reside

A temporary visitor's permitted activities and length of stay depend on the entry arrangement granted. A longer move requires a residence basis, such as employment, study or joining family. BOCA's [resident-visa guidance](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-165-1878-1ff5e-2.html) covers those purposes, while the National Immigration Agency (NIA) decides residence applications and issues the Alien Resident Certificate (ARC).

Some eligible visitors can apply directly to NIA. Other applicants need the appropriate visa before entry, so arriving as a visitor leaves no general right to convert a short stay into residence.

## An employment offer is the start of the application

For most foreign professional hires, the employer applies for a work permit, subject to statutory exceptions and the authority responsible for the job. [Articles 4 and 5 of the Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) define professional work and the permit framework. A signed offer is not work authorization.

Once a qualifying foreign professional or foreign specialist professional has the permit or an applicable exemption, Article 16 allows a direct residence application following visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. NIA must still approve the residence application before issuing an ARC. The current Article 16 took effect on January 1, 2026, as recorded in the Act's [legislative history](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawHistory.aspx?pcode=A0030295).

[NIA's guide](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141824/cp_news) excludes trial visa exemptions, the Southeast Asian online travel-authorization scheme and other listed entry arrangements from this direct-application route unless another rule applies, even where the applicant holds work approval.

Care work, fishing and other migrant-worker categories under [Employment Service Act Article 46](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001) have their own rules. NIA's [migrant-worker residence procedure](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/181964/) applies to those categories; employment in Taiwan does not by itself place a worker within the foreign-professional scheme. The category on the work approval identifies which procedure to use.

## Degree students and Mandarin learners

Full-time foreign students applying from abroad can seek a resident visa at a Taiwan overseas mission. Those who enter on a visitor visa specifically for foreign-student study may apply directly to NIA for residence. The ordinary in-country study route in [BOCA's student guidance](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-283-c4da3-2.html) excludes visa-exempt entry, landing visas and visitor visas issued for other purposes.

Depending on the application, BOCA also requires educational records, financial evidence and a health certificate alongside the admission letter; the program's checklist determines which overseas records need authentication.

For Mandarin learners, the [language-study visitor visa](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-158-260-9690c-2.html) ordinarily comes before arrival. Eligibility for residence follows four completed months at a qualifying university-affiliated center, with registration for at least three more months. [BOCA's Mandarin residence guidance](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-166-285-041cb-2.html) requires at least 15 classroom hours a week, Monday through Friday. Absences, including leave, may not exceed one quarter of class hours. Tuition payment alone does not establish eligibility.

Can a student take a part-time job? [Employment Service Act Articles 43 and 50](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001) govern work permits and specified student employment. The admission letter and student ARC do not replace the work authorization needed for the job.

## Joining a spouse or parent in Taiwan

Family residence depends on the sponsor's status and the relationship. For a spouse of a Taiwan national residing in Taiwan with household registration, one in-country route under [Immigration Act Article 23](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=23) requires a valid visa allowing a stay of at least 60 days and without the specified restrictions. Marriage therefore does not establish a general right to convert visa-exempt entry to residence. The required relationship documents and related status issues appear in [residence through a Taiwan spouse](/en/columns/taiwan-foreign-spouse-residence).

When a foreign professional engaged in professional work in Taiwan or a foreign specialist professional already has approved residence or permanent residence, [Article 16](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) allows certain family members to apply directly after visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. It covers a spouse, minor children, and adult children unable to care for themselves because of physical or mental disability. Parents and other adult children are excluded.

Work rights vary by family category. [Employment Service Act Article 48](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001) provides a work-permit exemption for an approved resident married to a Taiwan national with household registration. Dependent spouses of foreign professionals cannot assume that exemption applies to them. For qualifying spouses of specialist or senior professionals, [Foreign Professionals Act Article 15](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) provides a direct application for a work permit.

## Gold Cards, founders and longer visits

Specialist professionals who meet the program's criteria may qualify for an [Employment Gold Card](https://goldcard.nat.gov.tw/en/), which combines work, residence, visa and re-entry functions in one document. The [Gold Card article](/en/columns/taiwan-employment-gold-card) covers that application separately.

BOCA publishes the [entrepreneur route requirements](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-154-2.html) for applicants planning to establish a business in Taiwan.

Working-holiday access depends on the [nationality-specific program](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-153-2.html). The [digital-nomad visitor visa](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-158-7718-c0382-2.html) has separate nationality and qualification requirements and does not automatically lead to an ARC. [Foreign Professionals Act Article 14](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) limits that remote-work route to qualifying work without providing services to Taiwan businesses or employers.

Once the residence category and entry requirements are established, the [first ARC application guide](/en/columns/taiwan-arc-first-application) covers filing and collection. An existing resident moving to a new job, course or family basis also needs the [rules on renewal and changes](/en/columns/taiwan-arc-renewal-changes-reentry): the current card does not settle whether that new purpose qualifies.

Sources checked October 24, 2026. Eligibility still depends on the individual application. These routes concern foreign nationals; Mainland China residents, Hong Kong and Macau residents, and ROC nationals without household registration follow separate frameworks.

## Official sources

- [Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295), Articles 4, 5, 14, 15 and 16; [legislative history](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawHistory.aspx?pcode=A0030295).
- [Immigration Act, Article 23](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=23): qualifying in-country residence routes.
- [Employment Service Act](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001), Articles 43, 46, 48 and 50: work categories, permits, exemptions and student work.
- BOCA: [resident visas](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-165-1878-1ff5e-2.html), [foreign students](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-283-c4da3-2.html), [Mandarin visitor visas](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-158-260-9690c-2.html), [Mandarin residence](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-166-285-041cb-2.html).
- [NIA, residence applications after visitor-visa or visa-exempt entry](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141824/cp_news), note 7(1), updated April 14, 2026: excluded entry arrangements and exceptions under other applicable rules.
- [NIA, migrant-worker residence applications](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/181964/).
- Official [Employment Gold Card information](https://goldcard.nat.gov.tw/en/) and [BOCA entrepreneur materials](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-154-2.html).
- BOCA, [working-holiday programs](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-153-2.html) and [digital-nomad visitor visa](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-158-7718-c0382-2.html).
- [Taiwan overseas mission directory](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html): relevant consular offices.

Sprejem na univerzo še ne pove, s katerim vizumom naj študent pride na Tajvan. Pri običajni študijski poti lahko brezvizumski prihod onemogoči prijavo za prebivanje v državi, medtem ko [16. člen zakona o tujih strokovnjakih](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) nekaterim strokovnjakom takšno neposredno prijavo omogoča. Zato je treba namen selitve povezati z vstopnim statusom pred potovanjem.

[BOCA za redni študij](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-283-c4da3-2.html) in [učenje kitajščine](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-158-260-9690c-2.html) objavlja ločene pogoje. Državljanstvo in uporabljeni potni list vplivata na vizumsko upravičenost. Podrobnosti za konkretno prijavo poda [pristojno tajvansko predstavništvo](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html).

## Dovoljen obisk in podlaga za prebivanje

Kratkotrajno bivanje ima dovoljen namen in končni datum, ki izhajata iz odobrenega načina vstopa. Za daljšo selitev je potrebna podlaga za prebivanje, denimo delo, študij ali družinska vez. [Navodila BOCA za vizume za prebivanje](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-165-1878-1ff5e-2.html) obravnavajo te namene, o prebivanju in izkaznici ARC pa odloča Nacionalna agencija za priseljevanje, NIA.

Nekateri obiskovalci lahko zaprosijo neposredno pri NIA. Drugi potrebujejo ustrezen vizum že pred prihodom. Zgolj dejstvo, da ste zakonito vstopili in našli stanovanje, zato ne potrdi možnosti spremembe statusa.

## Ponudba za delo potrebuje ustrezno dovoljenje

Delodajalec pri večini zaposlitev tujih strokovnjakov zaprosi za delovno dovoljenje. [4. in 5. člen zakona o pridobivanju in zaposlovanju tujih strokovnjakov](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) določata strokovno delo, sistem dovoljenj in izjeme; pristojni organ je odvisen tudi od vrste dela. Podpisana ponudba sama ne dovoljuje začetka dela.

Ko ima tuji strokovnjak ali strokovnjak s posebnimi znanji dovoljenje za strokovno delo oziroma ustrezno zakonsko izjemo, mu 16. člen po brezvizumskem vstopu ali vstopu z vizumom za obisk omogoča neposredno prošnjo za prebivanje. NIA mora prošnjo odobriti, preden izda ARC. Sedanja ureditev tega člena velja od 1. januarja 2026, kot izhaja iz [uradne zgodovine zakona](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawHistory.aspx?pcode=A0030295).

Preveriti je treba natančno ureditev vstopa. [Navodila NIA](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141824/cp_news) iz te neposredne poti izključujejo poskusne brezvizumske ureditve, spletno potovalno dovoljenje za določene države jugovzhodne Azije in druge navedene možnosti, razen kadar se uporablja druga določba. Delovno dovoljenje samo ne odpravi teh omejitev.

Negovalno delo, ribištvo in druge kategorije delavcev po [46. členu zakona o zaposlitvenih storitvah](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001) imajo svoja pravila. Zanje NIA objavlja [poseben postopek za prebivanje delavcev](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/181964/). Kategorijo poiščite na odobritvi dela; vsaka zaposlitev na Tajvanu ne spada v sistem tujih strokovnjakov.

## Redni študij in tečaj kitajščine imata različne pogoje

Tuji študenti rednega študija lahko iz tujine zaprosijo za vizum za prebivanje pri tajvanskem predstavništvu. Kdor vstopi z vizumom za obisk, izdanim prav zaradi študija tujega študenta, lahko po ustrezni poti zaprosi neposredno pri NIA. Običajna prijava za študijsko prebivanje na Tajvanu po [navodilih BOCA](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-283-c4da3-2.html) ni na voljo po brezvizumskem vstopu, vizumu ob prihodu ali vizumu za obisk z drugim namenom.

Poleg sprejemnega pisma lahko konkretna prijava zahteva dokazila o izobrazbi, finančnih sredstvih in zdravstvenem pregledu. Seznam izbrane poti določa tudi overitve tujih listin. Shranite potrdilo, za kateri program in način študija ste bili sprejeti.

Pri učenju kitajščine se [vizum za obisk zaradi jezikovnega študija](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-158-260-9690c-2.html) praviloma pridobi pred prihodom. Za prebivanje je treba pri upravičenem jezikovnem centru, povezanem z univerzo, zaključiti štiri mesece učenja in se vpisati še za najmanj tri mesece. Po [navodilih BOCA za jezikovno prebivanje](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-166-285-041cb-2.html) mora pouk od ponedeljka do petka obsegati vsaj 15 ur na teden, odsotnosti skupaj z dovoljenimi izostanki pa ne smejo preseči četrtine učnih ur. Plačana šolnina teh pogojev ne nadomesti.

Ali študentski ARC omogoča popoldansko delo? [43. in 50. člen zakona o zaposlitvenih storitvah](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001) urejata potrebno dovoljenje in študentsko zaposlitev. Za študente, ki sodijo v to ureditev, je delo omejeno na 20 ur na teden, razen med poletnimi in zimskimi počitnicami. Izkaznica o prebivanju in sprejemno pismo sama ne nadomestita dovoljenja.

## Na kateri družinski status se opira prijava?

Pri zakoncu tajvanskega državljana sta pomembni njegovo prebivanje na Tajvanu in gospodinjska registracija. Ena od poti znotraj države po [23. členu zakona o priseljevanju](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=23) zahteva veljaven vizum, ki dovoljuje vsaj 60 dni bivanja, brez prepovedi podaljšanja in drugih navedenih omejitev. Poroka torej ne daje splošne pravice do spremembe brezvizumskega obiska v prebivanje. [Dokumentacija za zakonca tajvanskega državljana je podrobneje opisana v angleščini](/en/columns/taiwan-foreign-spouse-residence).

Za družino tujega strokovnjaka [16. člen posebnega zakona](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) loči dve možnosti. Družinski član na Tajvanu je lahko običajni tuji strokovnjak, ki tam opravlja strokovno delo, ali tuji strokovnjak s posebnimi znanji. V obeh primerih mora imeti pri NIA odobreno prebivanje ali stalno prebivanje.

Neposredno lahko po brezvizumskem vstopu ali vizumu za obisk zaprosijo njegov zakonec, mladoletni otroci in odrasli otroci, ki zaradi telesne ali duševne oviranosti ne morejo skrbeti zase. ARC dobijo po odobritvi. Staršev in drugih odraslih otrok ta določba ne vključuje. Pri drugih družinskih poteh je treba preveriti še zakonske izključitve glede statusa osebe, na katero se prijava opira.

Pravica do dela sledi lastnim pravilom. [48. člen zakona o zaposlitvenih storitvah](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001) dovoljuje izjemo od delovnega dovoljenja tujcu z odobrenim prebivanjem, ki je poročen s tajvanskim državljanom z gospodinjsko registracijo. Zakonec tujega strokovnjaka te izjeme ne pridobi samodejno. Upravičenemu zakoncu strokovnjaka s posebnimi znanji ali strokovnjaka na najvišji ravni [15. člen posebnega zakona](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) omogoča lastno prošnjo za delovno dovoljenje. Njegova veljavnost ne sme preseči dovoljenega družinskega prebivanja.

## Gold Card, ustanovitev podjetja in daljši obisk

[Employment Gold Card](https://goldcard.nat.gov.tw/en/) združuje delovno dovoljenje, vizum za prebivanje, ARC in dovoljenje za ponovni vstop. Namenjena je strokovnjakom s posebnimi znanji, ki izpolnijo merila programa, in velja od enega do treh let. O prošnji ni odločeno že s tem, da ima kandidat dobro ponudbo za delo. Ločena [razlaga prijave za Gold Card je v angleščini](/en/columns/taiwan-employment-gold-card).

Za ustanavljanje podjetja BOCA objavlja [pogoje podjetniške poti](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-154-2.html). Poslovni načrt je zato treba povezati s kategorijo prebivanja in njenimi dokazili, preden se zanesete na predvideni datum začetka poslovanja.

Delovne počitnice so vezane na [program za konkretno državljanstvo](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-153-2.html). [Vizum za obisk digitalnih nomadov](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-158-7718-c0382-2.html) ima druge pogoje glede državljanstva in upravičenosti ter ne vodi samodejno do ARC. [14. člen zakona o tujih strokovnjakih](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) to pot dela na daljavo omejuje na upravičeno delo brez opravljanja storitev za tajvanska podjetja ali delodajalce.

Ko je podlaga izbrana, [vodnik za prvi ARC](/sl/columns/taiwan-arc-first-application) poveže rok, listine in prevzem. Če ARC že imate in menjate službo, študij ali družinsko podlago, preverite [pravila o spremembi razloga in podaljšanju](/sl/columns/taiwan-arc-renewal-changes-reentry). V spisu naj bosta razvidna odobreni sedanji namen in dejanski namen po spremembi.

Besedilo uporablja uradne vire, preverjene 24. in 25. oktobra 2026. Obravnava tuje državljane; prebivalci celinske Kitajske, Hongkonga in Macaa ter tajvanski državljani brez gospodinjske registracije imajo ločene pravne okvire. Upravičenost je treba ugotoviti za konkretnega prosilca.

## Uradni viri

- [Zakon o pridobivanju in zaposlovanju tujih strokovnjakov](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295), 4., 5., 9., 14., 15. in 16. člen; [uradna zgodovina](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawHistory.aspx?pcode=A0030295).
- [Zakon o priseljevanju, 23. člen](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=23): upravičene prijave za prebivanje v državi.
- [Zakon o zaposlitvenih storitvah](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001), 43., 46., 48. in 50. člen: kategorije dela, dovoljenja in študenti.
- BOCA: [vizumi za prebivanje](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-165-1878-1ff5e-2.html), [redni tuji študenti](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-283-c4da3-2.html), [vizumi za obisk zaradi kitajščine](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-158-260-9690c-2.html), [prebivanje zaradi kitajščine](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-166-285-041cb-2.html).
- [NIA, prijava po vizumu za obisk ali brezvizumskem vstopu](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141824/cp_news), opomba 7(1), posodobljeno 14. aprila 2026: izključene ureditve vstopa in druge zakonske podlage.
- [NIA, prebivanje delavcev v posebnih zaposlitvenih kategorijah](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/181964/).
- [Uradne informacije o Gold Card](https://goldcard.nat.gov.tw/en/) in [podjetniška gradiva BOCA](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-154-2.html).
- BOCA: [delovne počitnice](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-153-2.html) in [vizum digitalnih nomadov](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-158-7718-c0382-2.html).
- [Imenik tajvanskih predstavništev](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html): pristojni konzularni urad.

sourceEvidence.text: Article 16 of the Foreign Professionals Act allows qualifying professionals with work authorization or an exemption, and certain family members, to apply directly to NIA. Eligibility also depends on the entry arrangement used. Ordinary degree-study and Mandarin-study routes have different entry requirements.

Visa-exempt entry may suit a qualifying professional who intends to apply for residence in Taiwan, but it can rule out the ordinary in-country application for a degree or Mandarin student. Foreign Professionals Act Article 16 permits the professional route; BOCA's degree-study and Mandarin-study guidance set different entry conditions for students.

For most foreign professional hires, the employer applies for a work permit, subject to statutory exceptions and the authority responsible for the job. Articles 4 and 5 of the Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals define professional work and the permit framework. A signed offer is not work authorization.

Once a qualifying foreign professional or foreign specialist professional has the permit or an applicable exemption, Article 16 allows a direct residence application following visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. NIA must still approve the residence application before issuing an ARC. The current Article 16 took effect on January 1, 2026, as recorded in the Act's legislative history.

Care work, fishing and other migrant-worker categories under Employment Service Act Article 46 have their own rules. NIA's migrant-worker residence procedure applies to those categories; employment in Taiwan does not by itself place a worker within the foreign-professional scheme. The category on the work approval identifies which procedure to use.

For Mandarin learners, the language-study visitor visa ordinarily comes before arrival. Eligibility for residence follows four completed months at a qualifying university-affiliated center, with registration for at least three more months. BOCA's Mandarin residence guidance requires at least 15 classroom hours a week, Monday through Friday. Absences, including leave, may not exceed one quarter of class hours. Tuition payment alone does not establish eligibility.

Can a student take a part-time job? Employment Service Act Articles 43 and 50 govern work permits and specified student employment. The admission letter and student ARC do not replace the work authorization needed for the job.

Family residence depends on the sponsor's status and the relationship. For a spouse of a Taiwan national residing in Taiwan with household registration, one in-country route under Immigration Act Article 23 requires a valid visa allowing a stay of at least 60 days and without the specified restrictions. Marriage therefore does not establish a general right to convert visa-exempt entry to residence. The required relationship documents and related status issues appear in residence through a Taiwan spouse.

When a foreign professional engaged in professional work in Taiwan or a foreign specialist professional already has approved residence or permanent residence, Article 16 allows certain family members to apply directly after visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. It covers a spouse, minor children, and adult children unable to care for themselves because of physical or mental disability. Parents and other adult children are excluded.

Work rights vary by family category. Employment Service Act Article 48 provides a work-permit exemption for an approved resident married to a Taiwan national with household registration. Dependent spouses of foreign professionals cannot assume that exemption applies to them. For qualifying spouses of specialist or senior professionals, Foreign Professionals Act Article 15 provides a direct application for a work permit.

Working-holiday access depends on the nationality-specific program. The digital-nomad visitor visa has separate nationality and qualification requirements and does not automatically lead to an ARC. Foreign Professionals Act Article 14 limits that remote-work route to qualifying work without providing services to Taiwan businesses or employers.

targetEvidence.text: Za upravičene tuje strokovnjake z delovnim dovoljenjem ali ustrezno izjemo 16. člen posebnega zakona omogoča neposredno prijavo pri NIA. Posebej določa pot za nekatere družinske člane. Preveriti je treba tudi uporabljeno ureditev vstopa. Običajni poti za študij in učenje kitajščine imata drugačne vstopne pogoje.

Sprejem na univerzo še ne pove, s katerim vizumom naj študent pride na Tajvan. Pri običajni študijski poti lahko brezvizumski prihod onemogoči prijavo za prebivanje v državi, medtem ko 16. člen zakona o tujih strokovnjakih nekaterim strokovnjakom takšno neposredno prijavo omogoča. Zato je treba namen selitve povezati z vstopnim statusom pred potovanjem.

Delodajalec pri večini zaposlitev tujih strokovnjakov zaprosi za delovno dovoljenje. 4. in 5. člen zakona o pridobivanju in zaposlovanju tujih strokovnjakov določata strokovno delo, sistem dovoljenj in izjeme; pristojni organ je odvisen tudi od vrste dela. Podpisana ponudba sama ne dovoljuje začetka dela.

Ko ima tuji strokovnjak ali strokovnjak s posebnimi znanji dovoljenje za strokovno delo oziroma ustrezno zakonsko izjemo, mu 16. člen po brezvizumskem vstopu ali vstopu z vizumom za obisk omogoča neposredno prošnjo za prebivanje. NIA mora prošnjo odobriti, preden izda ARC. Sedanja ureditev tega člena velja od 1. januarja 2026, kot izhaja iz uradne zgodovine zakona.

Negovalno delo, ribištvo in druge kategorije delavcev po 46. členu zakona o zaposlitvenih storitvah imajo svoja pravila. Zanje NIA objavlja poseben postopek za prebivanje delavcev. Kategorijo poiščite na odobritvi dela; vsaka zaposlitev na Tajvanu ne spada v sistem tujih strokovnjakov.

Pri učenju kitajščine se vizum za obisk zaradi jezikovnega študija praviloma pridobi pred prihodom. Za prebivanje je treba pri upravičenem jezikovnem centru, povezanem z univerzo, zaključiti štiri mesece učenja in se vpisati še za najmanj tri mesece. Po navodilih BOCA za jezikovno prebivanje mora pouk od ponedeljka do petka obsegati vsaj 15 ur na teden, odsotnosti skupaj z dovoljenimi izostanki pa ne smejo preseči četrtine učnih ur. Plačana šolnina teh pogojev ne nadomesti.

Ali študentski ARC omogoča popoldansko delo? 43. in 50. člen zakona o zaposlitvenih storitvah urejata potrebno dovoljenje in študentsko zaposlitev. Za študente, ki sodijo v to ureditev, je delo omejeno na 20 ur na teden, razen med poletnimi in zimskimi počitnicami. Izkaznica o prebivanju in sprejemno pismo sama ne nadomestita dovoljenja.

Pri zakoncu tajvanskega državljana sta pomembni njegovo prebivanje na Tajvanu in gospodinjska registracija. Ena od poti znotraj države po 23. členu zakona o priseljevanju zahteva veljaven vizum, ki dovoljuje vsaj 60 dni bivanja, brez prepovedi podaljšanja in drugih navedenih omejitev. Poroka torej ne daje splošne pravice do spremembe brezvizumskega obiska v prebivanje. Dokumentacija za zakonca tajvanskega državljana je podrobneje opisana v angleščini.

Za družino tujega strokovnjaka 16. člen posebnega zakona loči dve možnosti. Družinski član na Tajvanu je lahko običajni tuji strokovnjak, ki tam opravlja strokovno delo, ali tuji strokovnjak s posebnimi znanji. V obeh primerih mora imeti pri NIA odobreno prebivanje ali stalno prebivanje.

Pravica do dela sledi lastnim pravilom. 48. člen zakona o zaposlitvenih storitvah dovoljuje izjemo od delovnega dovoljenja tujcu z odobrenim prebivanjem, ki je poročen s tajvanskim državljanom z gospodinjsko registracijo. Zakonec tujega strokovnjaka te izjeme ne pridobi samodejno. Upravičenemu zakoncu strokovnjaka s posebnimi znanji ali strokovnjaka na najvišji ravni 15. člen posebnega zakona omogoča lastno prošnjo za delovno dovoljenje. Njegova veljavnost ne sme preseči dovoljenega družinskega prebivanja.

Delovne počitnice so vezane na program za konkretno državljanstvo. Vizum za obisk digitalnih nomadov ima druge pogoje glede državljanstva in upravičenosti ter ne vodi samodejno do ARC. 14. člen zakona o tujih strokovnjakih to pot dela na daljavo omejuje na upravičeno delo brez opravljanja storitev za tajvanska podjetja ali delodajalce.

Besedilo uporablja uradne vire, preverjene 24. in 25. oktobra 2026. Obravnava tuje državljane; prebivalci celinske Kitajske, Hongkonga in Macaa ter tajvanski državljani brez gospodinjske registracije imajo ločene pravne okvire. Upravičenost je treba ugotoviti za konkretnega prosilca.

Kdaj lahko vložim prošnjo za podaljšanje ARC?

faq.q: How early can I renew my ARC?
faq.a: The general extension window opens three months before authorized residence expires. Gold Card renewal and qualifying entrepreneur ARC extensions for a continuing Taiwan business have separate four-month windows. These are advance filing periods, not grace periods after expiry.

faq.q: When must I report a move or a change in workplace?
faq.a: NIA registration is due within 30 days counted from the day after the change. A new employer may also require work authorization, and a change in the basis for residence may require a separate application. Updating the address or workplace record does not complete those procedures.

faq.q: Can I return to Taiwan with an ARC renewal receipt?
faq.a: A receipt should not be assumed to replace the required travel documents. Before departure, ask NIA what document covers your return if the renewed card is still pending. Your passport, residence status and re-entry permission must cover the journey.

sourcePassages.text: Can you stay until the expiry date printed on your Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if the job, course or family relationship supporting it ends sooner? Immigration Act Article 31 requires the National Immigration Agency (NIA) to revoke residence permission and cancel the card when the reason for residence disappears, subject to the statutory grounds on which NIA may approve continued residence.

The date of that change can trigger an application well before the card expires. Keep the notice recording it. An employment termination notice, graduation record or family-status document helps establish what happened and when; a new lease records a move. NIA's residence guide requires evidence suited to the extension or change requested.
Situation
Application period
Ordinary ARC renewal
During the three months before residence expires, with the application filed before the current permission ends.
Change of residence address or place of employment
Within 30 days counted from the day after the change.
Change of residence reason qualifying under Immigration Act Article 23-1
Application to NIA within 30 days from the event date.
Change of residence reason outside Article 23-1
The residence regulations prescribe a new resident-visa application to BOCA within 15 days from the event, followed by the NIA residence application.

Immigration Act Article 31 governs address and workplace registration; Articles 7 and 9 of the residence regulations govern changes of residence reason and extensions. Address changes are counted from the following day, while the regulations count a change of residence reason from the event date.

Some programs allow an earlier renewal application. A qualifying entrepreneur ARC extension for a continuing Taiwan business can be filed during the four months before expiry. The separate continued-residence route after that business ceases has a three-month advance window. Gold Card renewal opens four months before expiry.

An ordinary extension requires the form, passport, existing ARC, photograph and current evidence of the reason for residence. NIA's guide calls for employment, study or family documents as appropriate, plus new address evidence if you have moved.

The supporting documents need to cover the requested period. An employment-based extension depends on the relevant employment permission, while a student's enrollment records support the study period sought. Obtaining those records in advance leaves time to address an expiring work approval or incomplete enrollment evidence before the ARC application is due.

Mandarin-study extensions are more limited. Under the NIA student guide, each extension follows the enrollment evidence and is capped at six months. The combined stay and residence period is generally limited to two years.

Standard extension fees are NT$1,000 per year of approved validity; a shorter period is charged as one year under Article 3 of the immigration permit fee standards. The residence category determines the period NIA may approve. Paying for a longer period does not create an entitlement to it.

Already past expiry? Contact NIA immediately. Article 31 allows a limited reapplication after a penalty when the overstay is less than 30 days and the original residence reason continues. That provision leaves the original expiry date unchanged; it is not an ordinary grace period.

A move requires new address evidence and NIA registration within the 30-day period. Updating a bank, university or employer's records does not complete the immigration registration required by Article 31. Keep the dated submission record.

For a new employer or an additional job, Employment Service Act Article 53 sets requirements that differ by worker category. The new work must be covered by the applicable permit or exemption before it begins. An NIA address or workplace update does not itself authorize that employment.

After graduation, termination of employment or a family-status change, an ARC holder may apply for a new residence basis under Immigration Act Article 23-1 only in the situations that provision lists.

Continued residence may also be available under Article 31, including specified circumstances involving a deceased family sponsor, domestic violence, children in Taiwan, labor litigation or an occupational injury. Each ground has its own conditions, so a divorce or employment dispute alone does not establish either a right to remain or an inevitable obligation to leave.

Qualifying professionals can seek the extension in Foreign Professionals Act Article 17. If approved, it runs for six months from the day after the original ARC or Gold Card expires. One further extension is available, up to a total of one year. Apply before expiry. Graduates have a different extension framework under Article 11 of the residence regulations, with eligibility tied to the completed program; the professional timetable does not apply to every student.

An initial email to Hovering International Law Firm at wei@hoveringlaw.com.tw about an employment or family dispute affecting residence should state the event and relevant dates. Leave passport numbers and original identity documents out of that message.

A renewed passport requires a corresponding update to NIA's records, as its passport-renewal FAQ explains. For a data change, NIA's checklist requires the application, photograph, passport and evidence of the change. Keeping the old passport or a copy helps connect the old and new records.

NIA's guide lists the damaged card, a loss declaration, a police report or other evidence as appropriate when an ARC is lost or damaged. Article 7 of the fee standards sets the standard replacement fee at NT$500. Replacing the card does not extend residence.

Loss abroad also affects the return journey. Before attempting to travel back, contact NIA and the relevant Taiwan overseas mission with your passport details, an ARC copy if available, and intended return date. They can identify which document your circumstances require.

Re-entry requires valid permission under Immigration Act Article 34. Article 20 of the residence regulations ties that permission to the ARC's validity period and cancels it when the ARC is canceled. The permission recorded with the card therefore needs to cover the intended return date, along with the passport and residence status.

Before departing while a renewal or replacement is pending, obtain NIA's instructions for the actual journey. An application receipt should not be assumed to replace the required travel documents, particularly when the new card will not be ready before you leave.

Initial applications are covered in first ARC steps; a new residence purpose is covered in the work, study and family comparison. Permanent residence has its own requirements, addressed in APRC applications. For an upcoming trip, the immediate issue remains whether the documents you will carry cover the date you plan to return.

A move requires new address evidence and NIA registration within the 30-day period. Updating a bank, university or employer's records does not complete the immigration registration required by Article 31. Keep the dated submission record.

For a new employer or an additional job, Employment Service Act Article 53 sets requirements that differ by worker category. The new work must be covered by the applicable permit or exemption before it begins. An NIA address or workplace update does not itself authorize that employment.

After graduation, termination of employment or a family-status change, an ARC holder may apply for a new residence basis under Immigration Act Article 23-1 only in the situations that provision lists.

Continued residence may also be available under Article 31, including specified circumstances involving a deceased family sponsor, domestic violence, children in Taiwan, labor litigation or an occupational injury. Each ground has its own conditions, so a divorce or employment dispute alone does not establish either a right to remain or an inevitable obligation to leave.

Qualifying professionals can seek the extension in Foreign Professionals Act Article 17. If approved, it runs for six months from the day after the original ARC or Gold Card expires. One further extension is available, up to a total of one year. Apply before expiry. Graduates have a different extension framework under Article 11 of the residence regulations, with eligibility tied to the completed program; the professional timetable does not apply to every student.

An initial email to Hovering International Law Firm at wei@hoveringlaw.com.tw about an employment or family dispute affecting residence should state the event and relevant dates. Leave passport numbers and original identity documents out of that message.

A renewed passport requires a corresponding update to NIA's records, as its passport-renewal FAQ explains. For a data change, NIA's checklist requires the application, photograph, passport and evidence of the change. Keeping the old passport or a copy helps connect the old and new records.

NIA's guide lists the damaged card, a loss declaration, a police report or other evidence as appropriate when an ARC is lost or damaged. Article 7 of the fee standards sets the standard replacement fee at NT$500. Replacing the card does not extend residence.

Loss abroad also affects the return journey. Before attempting to travel back, contact NIA and the relevant Taiwan overseas mission with your passport details, an ARC copy if available, and intended return date. They can identify which document your circumstances require.

Re-entry requires valid permission under Immigration Act Article 34. Article 20 of the residence regulations ties that permission to the ARC's validity period and cancels it when the ARC is canceled. The permission recorded with the card therefore needs to cover the intended return date, along with the passport and residence status.

Before departing while a renewal or replacement is pending, obtain NIA's instructions for the actual journey. An application receipt should not be assumed to replace the required travel documents, particularly when the new card will not be ready before you leave.

Initial applications are covered in first ARC steps; a new residence purpose is covered in the work, study and family comparison. Permanent residence has its own requirements, addressed in APRC applications. For an upcoming trip, the immediate issue remains whether the documents you will carry cover the date you plan to return.

Legal sources checked October 24, 2026. This guide describes foreign-national procedures and category-specific exceptions, without determining an individual case. Mainland China residents, Hong Kong and Macau residents, and ROC nationals without household registration follow separate frameworks.

The general extension window opens three months before authorized residence expires. Gold Card renewal and qualifying entrepreneur ARC extensions for a continuing Taiwan business have separate four-month windows. These are advance filing periods, not grace periods after expiry.
When must I report a move or a change in workplace?

NIA registration is due within 30 days counted from the day after the change. A new employer may also require work authorization, and a change in the basis for residence may require a separate application. Updating the address or workplace record does not complete those procedures.

A receipt should not be assumed to replace the required travel documents. Before departure, ask NIA what document covers your return if the renewed card is still pending. Your passport, residence status and re-entry permission must cover the journey.

targetPassages.text: Nova najemna pogodba lahko sproži prijavno obveznost več mesecev pred datumom, natisnjenim na ARC. Prenehanje zaposlitve lahko vpliva še na samo dovoljenje za prebivanje. Po 31. členu zakona o priseljevanju mora Nacionalna agencija za priseljevanje, NIA, ob prenehanju razloga praviloma preklicati dovoljenje in razveljaviti izkaznico, ob zakonskih možnostih za odobritev nadaljnjega prebivanja.

Shranite listino z datumom spremembe. Obvestilo o prenehanju dela, dokazilo o zaključku študija in družinska listina pojasnijo različne dogodke; najemna pogodba pomaga dokazati selitev. Navodila NIA zahtevajo dokazila, ki ustrezajo prav zahtevani spremembi ali podaljšanju.
Dogodek ali prošnja
Obdobje za vložitev
Običajno podaljšanje ARC
V zadnjih treh mesecih pred iztekom dovoljenega prebivanja, pred njegovim potekom.
Sprememba naslova ali kraja dela
Prošnja za vpis pri NIA v 30 dneh od dne po spremembi.
Sprememba razloga prebivanja v primerih iz 23-1. člena zakona o priseljevanju
Prošnja pri NIA v 30 dneh od dne dogodka.
Sprememba razloga zunaj 23-1. člena
Nova prošnja za vizum za prebivanje pri BOCA ali njegovi izpostavi v 15 dneh od dogodka, nato postopek pri NIA.

31. člen ureja vpis naslova in kraja dela, 7. in 9. člen pravil o prebivanju tujcev pa spremembo razloga in podaljšanje. Pri naslovu se štetje začne naslednji dan. Pri spremembi razloga začne teči že na dan dogodka; poti s 15 in 30 dnevi sta odvisni od pogojev, med njima prosilec ne izbira poljubno.

Posebni programi dopuščajo zgodnejšo prijavo. Upravičeno podaljšanje podjetniškega ARC ob nadaljevanju poslovanja na Tajvanu se lahko vloži v zadnjih štirih mesecih pred iztekom. Če to poslovanje preneha in podjetnik potrebuje nadaljnje prebivanje, ima posebna pot trimesečno prijavno obdobje pred iztekom sedanjega dovoljenja. Za podaljšanje same Gold Card se obdobje odpre štiri mesece pred iztekom.

Običajna vloga potrebuje obrazec, potni list, sedanji ARC, fotografijo in aktualna dokazila o razlogu prebivanja. Po seznamu NIA so to ustrezne zaposlitvene, študijske ali družinske listine. Ob selitvi je treba dodati dokazilo o novem naslovu.

Dokazila naj pokrivajo zaprošeno obdobje. Če delovno dovoljenje poteče prej, je treba urediti tudi to vprašanje, študent pa potrebuje vpis, ki podpira čas nadaljnjega študija. Zgodnja pridobitev potrdila pokaže manjkajoče podatke, dokler je za dopolnitev še čas.

Podaljšanje zaradi učenja kitajščine je po študentskih navodilih NIA vezano na dokazano učno obdobje in je vsakič omejeno na največ šest mesecev. Kratkotrajno bivanje in prebivanje skupaj sta praviloma omejena na dve leti. Te omejitve ni mogoče obiti s plačilom pristojbine za daljše obdobje.

Običajna pristojbina za podaljšanje po 3. členu pravil o pristojbinah znaša NT$1.000 na leto odobrene veljavnosti; krajše obdobje se obračuna kot leto. Dovoljeni razlog določa, za koliko časa je podaljšanje sploh mogoče.

Je veljavnost že potekla? Takoj se obrnite na NIA. 31. člen omogoča omejeno ponovno prijavo po kaznovanju, če prekoračitev traja manj kot 30 dni in prvotni razlog prebivanja še obstaja. Določa tudi odbitek enega leta pri izračunu obdobja za stalno prebivanje. Prvotni datum izteka ostane nespremenjen; zakon ne daje splošnega nekaznovanega dodatnega meseca.
Za spremembo naslova je treba pri NIA zaprositi za vpis v 30 dneh od dne po selitvi. Obvestilo banki ali univerzi ne izpolni prijavne obveznosti po 31. členu. Ohranite dokazilo o oddaji z datumom.

Pri menjavi delodajalca ali dodatnem delu 53. člen zakona o zaposlitvenih storitvah razlikuje med kategorijami delavcev. Ustrezno dovoljenje ali izjema mora novo delo pokrivati, preden se začne. Za prehod k drugemu delodajalcu zakon v predpisanem obsegu zahteva tudi dokazilo o prenehanju prejšnjega razmerja; te zahteve ni primerno samodejno prenesti na vsako dodatno zaposlitev. Posodobitev kraja dela pri NIA sama ne odobri novega dela.

Po zaključku študija, izgubi službe ali spremembi družinskega položaja je prošnja za nov razlog po 23-1. členu zakona o priseljevanju mogoča le v tam navedenih primerih. Novo razmerje je treba dokazati. Datum na stari izkaznici ne potrjuje, da so novi pogoji izpolnjeni.

31. člen omogoča odobritev nadaljnjega prebivanja tudi v določenih primerih smrti družinskega člana, nasilja v družini, otrok na Tajvanu, delovnega spora ali poškodbe pri delu. Pri izjemi zaradi razveze po nasilju v družini mora iti za tujega zakonca tajvanskega državljana, ki prebiva na Tajvanu in ima gospodinjsko registracijo; tuji prosilec se po razvezi zaradi tega nasilja ne sme ponovno poročiti.

Pri otrocih veljajo pogoji konkretne zakonske določbe, med drugim glede mladoletnega otroka s tajvansko gospodinjsko registracijo. Delovni spor mora biti v postopku pravnega reševanja, poškodba pri delu pa v zdravljenju. Gre za možnost odobritve, ki jo NIA presodi po ustrezni podlagi. Vsaka razveza ali nesoglasje z delodajalcem zato ne zagotavlja nadaljnjega prebivanja.

Za upravičene strokovnjake 17. člen posebnega zakona predvideva prošnjo pred iztekom sedanjega ARC ali Gold Card; če je odobrena, dodatno obdobje traja šest mesecev od dne po izteku prejšnjega dokumenta. Dovoljeno je še eno podaljšanje, skupaj največ eno leto. Ta postopek je ločen od obnove same Gold Card.

Upravičeni diplomanti imajo po 11. členu pravil o prebivanju drugo pot: pred iztekom zaprosijo za eno leto in nato še za eno podaljšanje, skupaj največ dve leti. Upravičenost je vezana na predpisani zaključeni študij. Končan jezikovni tečaj sam ne daje položaja diplomanta po tej določbi.

Tudi delo med dodatnim prebivanjem potrebuje ustrezno podlago. 12. člen zakona o tujih strokovnjakih določa izjemo od delovnega dovoljenja za nove diplomante, ki so na Tajvanu pridobili diplomo stopnje associate degree ali višje, in jim je NIA odobrila predpisano podaljšanje prebivanja za diplomante. Izjema velja v tem dovoljenem obdobju. Ni splošna pravica vsakega nekdanjega študenta ali vsakega imetnika dokumenta za iskanje zaposlitve.

Za prvo vprašanje o sporu, ki vpliva na prebivanje, lahko pisarni Hovering International Law Firm na wei@hoveringlaw.com.tw navedete dogodek, pomembne datume in neobčutljiv povzetek. Osebnih dokumentov, številke potnega lista in bančnih podatkov ne vključujte. Posveti so v angleščini, kitajščini, japonščini ali korejščini; jezikovni dogovor se potrdi vnaprej, sporočilo samo pa še ne vzpostavi razmerja med odvetnikom in stranko.

Po obnovi potnega lista je potrebna tudi posodobitev podatkov pri NIA, kot pojasnjuje njen odgovor o potnih listih. Seznam za spremembe vključuje obrazec, fotografijo, potni list in dokazilo o spremenjenem podatku. Stari potni list ali kopija olajša povezavo med zapisoma. Za vse spremembe potnega lista ni mogoče iz teh splošnih navodil sklepati na en sam tridesetdnevni rok.

Če je ARC izgubljen ali poškodovan, NIA glede na primer zahteva poškodovano kartico, izjavo o izgubi, policijsko poročilo ali drugo ustrezno dokazilo. Običajna pristojbina za nadomestni ARC po 7. členu pravil o pristojbinah je NT$500. Nadomestna kartica ne podaljša prebivanja.

Izguba ARC v tujini odpira še vprašanje vrnitve. Pred potjo se obrnite na NIA in pristojno tajvansko predstavništvo, da preverita potrebni dokument za vaš položaj. Za uradni postopek pripravite podatke potnega lista, kopijo ARC, če jo imate, ter predvideni datum vrnitve. Možnost urejanja dokumenta iz tujine sama ne zagotavlja vkrcanja ali vstopa.

Potrebno dovoljenje za ponovni vstop po 34. členu zakona o priseljevanju uredite pred odhodom. 20. člen pravil o prebivanju ga omejuje z veljavnostjo ARC in predvideva njegovo razveljavitev ob razveljavitvi ARC, zato mora odobritev skupaj s potnim listom pokrivati nameravani datum vrnitve. Imetniki odobrenega stalnega prebivanja lahko po posebni zakonski ureditvi ponovno vstopijo z veljavnim potnim listom in APRC.

Pri določenem spletnem postopku za tuje strokovnjake in njihove družine NIA po odhodu prosilca med prijavo obravnave ne nadaljuje. Po ponovnem vstopu lahko ta znova zaprosi, če še izpolnjuje pogoje te poti. To je posledica navedenega postopka, ne splošna prepoved vseh potovanj med vsako prijavo za ARC.

Če ob odhodu nove kartice še ne boste imeli, pridobite navodila NIA za konkretno vrnitev. Potrdilo o oddaji, fotografija kartice in številka zadeve ne nadomestijo potrebnih potovalnih listin. Prva prijava, izbira novega namena prebivanja in stalno prebivanje APRC, opisano v angleščini, imajo svoje pogoje. Načrt potovanja zaključite z dokumentom, ki dejansko velja na dan vrnitve.

Pravni in uradni viri so bili preverjeni 24. in 25. oktobra 2026. Besedilo opisuje postopke za tuje državljane in pogoje posameznih izjem. Prebivalci celinske Kitajske, Hongkonga in Macaa ter tajvanski državljani brez gospodinjske registracije sledijo ločenim pravnim okvirom.
Zakon o priseljevanju: 23-1. člen, 31. člen, 34. člen.
Pravila o obiskih, prebivanju in stalnem prebivanju tujcev, 7., 9., 11. in 20. člen: roki, diplomanti in ponovni vstop.
Zakon o pridobivanju in zaposlovanju tujih strokovnjakov, 12. in 17. člen: delo upravičenih novih diplomantov in dodatno prebivanje strokovnjakov.
Zakon o zaposlitvenih storitvah, 53. člen: menjavanje oziroma dodajanje delodajalcev.
NIA 0902, prebivanje, podaljšanje in spremembe: listine in nadomestne kartice.
NIA, podjetniki, opombi 3 in 6; NIA, Gold Card, opomba 6: posebna obdobja za prijavo.
NIA 0929, študentske spletne prijave: jezikovno prebivanje.
NIA, vprašanja o potnem listu in izgubi ARC, vprašanji 2 in 3.
Pravila o pristojbinah za dovoljenja, 3. in 7. člen: podaljšanje in nadomestna kartica.
Imenik tajvanskih predstavništev: uradni poizvedovalni postopki v tujini.
NIA, spletne prijave strokovnjakov in družin, opomba 9: učinek odhoda med obravnavo.
Rok določa dogodek, zaradi katerega vlagate prošnjo
Podaljšanje ob nadaljevanju dela, študija ali družinske vezi
Nov naslov ali delodajalec zahtevata svoja dokazila
Ko dosedanja podlaga prebivanja preneha
Nov potni list in izgubljena kartica
Odhod med obravnavo in dokument za vrnitev
Uradni viri
Kdaj lahko vložim prošnjo za podaljšanje ARC?

Običajna prošnja se vloži v zadnjih treh mesecih pred iztekom dovoljenega prebivanja in pred samim iztekom. Za podaljšanje Gold Card in upravičenega podjetniškega ARC ob nadaljevanju poslovanja veljata posebni štirimesečni obdobji pred iztekom. To niso dodatni meseci po poteku dovoljenja.
Do kdaj moram prijaviti selitev ali spremembo delovnega mesta?

Za vpis spremembe pri NIA je treba zaprositi v 30 dneh od dne po spremembi. Nova zaposlitev lahko zahteva tudi delovno dovoljenje, spremenjeni razlog prebivanja pa svojo prošnjo. Vloga za posodobitev naslova ali kraja dela teh postopkov ne nadomesti.
Ali za vrnitev na Tajvan zadošča potrdilo o vloženi prošnji za ARC?

Potrdilo ne nadomesti zahtevanih potovalnih dokumentov. Pred odhodom pri NIA preverite dokument za svojo vrnitev, če nove kartice še ne bo. Potni list, prebivanje in potrebno dovoljenje za ponovni vstop morajo pokrivati potovanje; za imetnike stalnega prebivanja velja posebna ureditev z veljavnim potnim listom in APRC.

Can you stay until the expiry date printed on your Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if the job, course or family relationship supporting it ends sooner? [Immigration Act Article 31](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=31) requires the National Immigration Agency (NIA) to revoke residence permission and cancel the card when the reason for residence disappears, subject to the statutory grounds on which NIA may approve continued residence.

The date of that change can trigger an application well before the card expires. Keep the notice recording it. An employment termination notice, graduation record or family-status document helps establish what happened and when; a new lease records a move. [NIA's residence guide](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970) requires evidence suited to the extension or change requested.

## The filing date depends on what changed

| Situation | Application period |
|---|---|
| Ordinary ARC renewal | During the three months before residence expires, with the application filed before the current permission ends. |
| Change of residence address or place of employment | Within 30 days counted from the day after the change. |
| Change of residence reason qualifying under Immigration Act Article 23-1 | Application to NIA within 30 days from the event date. |
| Change of residence reason outside Article 23-1 | The residence regulations prescribe a new resident-visa application to BOCA within 15 days from the event, followed by the NIA residence application. |

[Immigration Act Article 31](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=31) governs address and workplace registration; [Articles 7 and 9 of the residence regulations](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080129) govern changes of residence reason and extensions. Address changes are counted from the following day, while the regulations count a change of residence reason from the event date.

Some programs allow an earlier renewal application. A qualifying [entrepreneur ARC extension for a continuing Taiwan business](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/348924/) can be filed during the four months before expiry. The separate continued-residence route after that business ceases has a three-month advance window. [Gold Card renewal](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/406403/) opens four months before expiry.

## Renewal while the job, course or family basis continues

An ordinary extension requires the form, passport, existing ARC, photograph and current evidence of the reason for residence. [NIA's guide](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970) calls for employment, study or family documents as appropriate, plus new address evidence if you have moved.

The supporting documents need to cover the requested period. An employment-based extension depends on the relevant employment permission, while a student's enrollment records support the study period sought. Obtaining those records in advance leaves time to address an expiring work approval or incomplete enrollment evidence before the ARC application is due.

Mandarin-study extensions are more limited. Under the [NIA student guide](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news), each extension follows the enrollment evidence and is capped at six months. The combined stay and residence period is generally limited to two years.

Standard extension fees are NT$1,000 per year of approved validity; a shorter period is charged as one year under [Article 3 of the immigration permit fee standards](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080135). The residence category determines the period NIA may approve. Paying for a longer period does not create an entitlement to it.

Already past expiry? Contact NIA immediately. [Article 31](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=31) allows a limited reapplication after a penalty when the overstay is less than 30 days and the original residence reason continues. That provision leaves the original expiry date unchanged; it is not an ordinary grace period.

## A move or a new employer

A move requires new address evidence and NIA registration within the 30-day period. Updating a bank, university or employer's records does not complete the immigration registration required by [Article 31](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=31). Keep the dated submission record.

For a new employer or an additional job, [Employment Service Act Article 53](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001) sets requirements that differ by worker category. The new work must be covered by the applicable permit or exemption before it begins. An NIA address or workplace update does not itself authorize that employment.

## When the original reason for residence ends

After graduation, termination of employment or a family-status change, an ARC holder may apply for a new residence basis under [Immigration Act Article 23-1](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=23-1) only in the situations that provision lists.

Continued residence may also be available under [Article 31](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=31), including specified circumstances involving a deceased family sponsor, domestic violence, children in Taiwan, labor litigation or an occupational injury. Each ground has its own conditions, so a divorce or employment dispute alone does not establish either a right to remain or an inevitable obligation to leave.

Qualifying professionals can seek the extension in [Foreign Professionals Act Article 17](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295). If approved, it runs for six months from the day after the original ARC or Gold Card expires. One further extension is available, up to a total of one year. Apply before expiry. Graduates have a different extension framework under [Article 11 of the residence regulations](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080129), with eligibility tied to the completed program; the professional timetable does not apply to every student.

An initial email to Hovering International Law Firm at [wei@hoveringlaw.com.tw](mailto:wei@hoveringlaw.com.tw) about an employment or family dispute affecting residence should state the event and relevant dates. Leave passport numbers and original identity documents out of that message.

## Passport updates and replacement cards

A renewed passport requires a corresponding update to NIA's records, as its [passport-renewal FAQ](https://news.immigration.gov.tw/EasyPack/Detail/DDA469F4-E2D0-4A98-847C-21432DCC040E?lang=EN) explains. For a data change, [NIA's checklist](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970) requires the application, photograph, passport and evidence of the change. Keeping the old passport or a copy helps connect the old and new records.

NIA's guide lists the damaged card, a loss declaration, a police report or other evidence as appropriate when an ARC is lost or damaged. [Article 7 of the fee standards](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080135) sets the standard replacement fee at NT$500. Replacing the card does not extend residence.

Loss abroad also affects the return journey. Before attempting to travel back, contact NIA and the relevant [Taiwan overseas mission](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html) with your passport details, an ARC copy if available, and intended return date. They can identify which document your circumstances require.

## Travel before the new card arrives

Re-entry requires valid permission under [Immigration Act Article 34](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=34). [Article 20 of the residence regulations](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080129) ties that permission to the ARC's validity period and cancels it when the ARC is canceled. The permission recorded with the card therefore needs to cover the intended return date, along with the passport and residence status.

Before departing while a renewal or replacement is pending, obtain NIA's instructions for the actual journey. An application receipt should not be assumed to replace the required travel documents, particularly when the new card will not be ready before you leave.

Initial applications are covered in [first ARC steps](/en/columns/taiwan-arc-first-application); a new residence purpose is covered in the [work, study and family comparison](/en/columns/taiwan-visa-residence-work-study-family). Permanent residence has its own requirements, addressed in [APRC applications](/en/columns/taiwan-permanent-residence-aprc). For an upcoming trip, the immediate issue remains whether the documents you will carry cover the date you plan to return.
